name: Termino
tagline_en: Online booking for Croatian hair, beauty and nail salons — clients book in a couple of clicks 24/7, owners run the calendar from the web or the native iPhone app. Live on the App Store.
tagline_hr: Online rezervacije za frizerske, kozmetičke i nail salone — klijenti rezerviraju u par klikova 24/7, vlasnici vode kalendar s weba ili nativne iPhone aplikacije. Live na App Storeu.
description_en: Termino is a booking marketplace for Croatian salons. Each salon gets a public profile with services, staff, gallery, Instagram-style stories and Google reviews; clients pick a service, a time slot and confirm — no calls, no accounts, with email confirmation and a reminder the day before. Owners get a full dashboard: day and week calendar, manual bookings, client base, per-service daily limits, split shifts and a waitlist that automatically notifies the next client when a slot opens. Push notifications reach the owner as Web Push in the browser and as native APNs push in the iOS app. The whole platform is a static frontend on Netlify with Supabase (Postgres + RLS, edge functions) behind it, and the iPhone app is the same codebase wrapped in Capacitor — approved on the App Store after four review rounds. Free for salons and clients.
description_hr: Termino je platforma za rezervacije za hrvatske salone. Svaki salon dobiva javni profil s uslugama, djelatnicima, galerijom, storyjima i Google recenzijama; klijent odabere uslugu i termin te potvrdi — bez poziva i bez registracije, uz email potvrdu i podsjetnik dan ranije. Vlasnici imaju puni dashboard: dnevni i tjedni kalendar, ručne rezervacije, bazu klijenata, dnevne limite po usluzi, podijeljene smjene i listu čekanja koja automatski obavijesti sljedećeg klijenta kad se termin oslobodi. Push obavijesti vlasniku stižu kao Web Push u pregledniku i kao nativni APNs push u iOS aplikaciji. Cijela platforma je statički frontend na Netlifyju sa Supabaseom (Postgres + RLS, edge funkcije) u pozadini, a iPhone aplikacija je isti kod zapakiran u Capacitor — odobrena na App Storeu nakon četiri runde reviewa. Besplatno za salone i klijente.
tagline_de: Online-Buchung für kroatische Friseur-, Kosmetik- und Nagelsalons — Kunden buchen mit ein paar Klicks rund um die Uhr, Inhaber führen den Kalender im Web oder in der nativen iPhone-App. Live im App Store.
description_de: Termino ist ein Buchungsmarktplatz für kroatische Salons. Jeder Salon erhält ein öffentliches Profil mit Leistungen, Team, Galerie, Stories und Google-Bewertungen; Kunden wählen Leistung und Termin und bestätigen — ohne Anruf, ohne Konto, mit E-Mail-Bestätigung und Erinnerung am Vortag. Inhaber bekommen ein vollständiges Dashboard: Tages- und Wochenkalender, manuelle Buchungen, Kundenkartei, Tageslimits pro Leistung, geteilte Schichten und eine Warteliste, die den nächsten Kunden automatisch benachrichtigt, wenn ein Termin frei wird. Push-Benachrichtigungen erreichen den Inhaber als Web Push im Browser und als nativer APNs-Push in der iOS-App. Die Plattform ist ein statisches Frontend auf Netlify mit Supabase (Postgres + RLS, Edge Functions) dahinter; die iPhone-App ist derselbe Code in Capacitor — nach vier Review-Runden im App Store freigegeben. Kostenlos für Salons und Kunden.

name: Claimo
tagline_en: One email address for the insurer, garage, police and leasing company — AI reads every message and builds your claim for you.
tagline_hr: Jedna e-mail adresa za osiguranje, servis, policiju i leasing — AI čita svaku poruku i sam gradi tvoj slučaj.
description_en: After a car accident you suddenly deal with five parties at once — the insurer, the garage, the police, the leasing company, sometimes a lawyer. Each writes separately, nobody holds the whole picture, and the driver becomes the switchboard. Claimo gives every driver one dedicated email address to hand out to all of them. Claude reads each incoming message, decides which party sent it, extracts the registration plate, claim reference, amount and dates, and files it under the right case — several claims tracked in parallel, each with its own timeline. Every update comes with a plain-language summary and a clear next step. Documents, guides on total loss, GAP and replacement vehicles, and the full legal set are built in. Live demo on claimo.hr with a working AI pipeline, no sign-up.
description_hr: Nakon prometne nezgode odjednom komuniciraš s pet strana — osiguranje, servis, policija, leasing, ponekad odvjetnik. Svatko piše zasebno, nitko ne drži cjelinu, a vozač završi kao centrala. Claimo svakom vozaču daje jednu dediciranu e-mail adresu koju podijeli svima. Claude čita svaku pristiglu poruku, prepozna koja ju je strana poslala, izvuče registraciju, broj štete, iznos i datume te je složi pod pravi slučaj — više slučajeva paralelno, svaki sa svojim tijekom. Uz svaku promjenu ide sažetak na ljudskom jeziku i jasan sljedeći korak. Dokumenti, vodiči o totalnoj šteti, GAP-u i zamjenskom vozilu te kompletan pravni set su ugrađeni. Demo uživo na claimo.hr s pravim AI pipelineom, bez registracije.

name: Beba dnevnik
tagline_en: Baby tracker for new parents — feedings, bottles in ml, diapers, sleep and photos, synced between both parents with a single family code. On the App Store and Google Play.
tagline_hr: Dnevnik za novopečene roditelje — hranjenja, bočice u ml, pelene, spavanje i fotke, sinkronizirano između oba roditelja jednim obiteljskim kodom. Na App Storeu i Google Playu.
description_en: Beba dnevnik started as a favour for a friend who had just become a dad and grew into a full multi-platform product: a native SwiftUI iPhone app on the App Store, an Android app on Google Play and an installable web app — all sharing one Supabase backend. One tap starts a feeding; ending it asks how many ml and whether it was nursing, pumped milk or formula. Diapers (with an optional photo), sleep and notes take a couple of taps, several babies can be tracked side by side, and a reminder pings when the next feeding is due. Both parents see the same diary by entering a shared family code — no accounts, no tracking, offline-first. Statistics show every day at a glance and tapping a day opens its full timeline. Free, in Croatian, English and German.
description_hr: Beba dnevnik je krenuo kao usluga prijatelju koji je upravo postao tata i narastao u punokrvni multiplatformski proizvod: nativna SwiftUI aplikacija na App Storeu, Android aplikacija na Google Playu i instalabilna web aplikacija — sve na istom Supabase backendu. Jedan dodir pokreće hranjenje; na kraju upišeš koliko ml i je li bilo dojenje, izdojeno ili adaptirano mlijeko. Pelene (uz opcionalnu fotku), spavanje i bilješke idu u par dodira, više beba se prati paralelno, a podsjetnik javi kad je vrijeme za sljedeće hranjenje. Oba roditelja vide isti dnevnik unosom zajedničkog obiteljskog koda — bez računa, bez praćenja, offline-first. Statistika pokazuje svaki dan na dlanu, a dodir na dan otvara cijeli tijek. Besplatno, na hrvatskom, engleskom i njemačkom.

name: Bridge
tagline_en: One private console to run a dev agency — clients, revenue split, a unified calendar, and a daily-standup hub for your team.
tagline_hr: Jedan privatni konzol za vođenje dev agencije — klijenti, podjela prihoda, objedinjeni kalendar i daily-standup hub za tim.
description_en: Bridge is a single locked web console for a small dev agency or two-partner studio. Per-client revenue with the dev fee off the top and a profit split (5:5, 4:6, custom), dual-confirmation settlement (both partners confirm sent + received before it turns green), per-payment invoices and a full ledger. A unified calendar merges every client's Google or Outlook iCal feed into one subscribe link for all your devices. A daily-standup hub lets developers post Work / Blockers / Plan with screenshot previews, while role-based logins keep each developer to their own updates — enforced by Postgres row-level security, not just the UI. Dark mode, mobile-first, installable as an app. White-label: deploy your own on a free Supabase + Netlify in an afternoon. Live demo with sample data — no sign-up.
description_hr: Bridge je jedan zaključani web konzol za malu dev agenciju ili studio s dva partnera. Prihod po klijentu uz dev fee s vrha i podjelu profita (5:5, 4:6, custom), naplata s dvostrukom potvrdom (oba partnera potvrde poslano + primljeno prije nego se zazeleni), računi po uplati i kompletan ledger. Objedinjeni kalendar spaja svaki klijentski Google ili Outlook iCal feed u jedan link za sve uređaje. Daily-standup hub gdje developeri pišu Što / Blokeri / Plan uz preglede screenshotova, dok prijave po ulogama drže svakog developera na njegovim unosima — kroz Postgres row-level security, ne samo UI. Dark mode, mobile-first, instalira se kao aplikacija. White-label: svoju instancu digneš na besplatnom Supabaseu + Netlifyju u jedno popodne. Demo uživo s uzorcima podataka — bez registracije.

name: libro
tagline_en: Local personal accounting. Scans your folder, matches payments to invoices, AI-parses unknown PDFs. No SaaS.
tagline_hr: Lokalno osobno računovodstvo. Skenira folder, matcha uplate s računima, AI parsira nepoznate PDF-ove. Bez SaaS-a.
description_en: Cloud accounting tools want a recurring subscription, your tax ID, and read access to every invoice. libro doesn't. It runs on localhost:8765, scans a folder of PDF invoices and bank statements (XML camt.053 + PDF), matches payments to invoices by amount/date/supplier, and optionally forwards everything to your accountant via Gmail OAuth or Apple Mail. AI parsing via Claude is optional. Multi-bank parser, bilingual UI (EN/HR), dark mode, Swift WKWebView macOS wrapper. Live demo with fake data — try before you clone.
description_hr: Cloud računovodstveni alati žele mjesečnu pretplatu, tvoj OIB i pristup svim tvojim računima. libro to ne traži. Radi na localhost:8765, skenira folder s PDF računima i bankovnim izvodima (XML camt.053 + PDF), matcha uplate s računima po iznosu/datumu/dobavljaču, i opcionalno forwardira sve knjigovođi preko Gmail OAuth-a ili Apple Mail-a. AI parsiranje (Claude) je opcionalno. Multi-bank parser, dvojezičan UI (EN/HR), dark mode, Swift WKWebView macOS wrapper. Live demo s lažnim podacima — probaj prije cloniranja.

name: Hide Icons
tagline_en: Hide your macOS menu bar icons with one click. No private APIs, no Accessibility permission.
tagline_hr: Sakrij ikone u macOS menu baru jednim klikom. Bez private API-ja, bez Accessibility dozvole.
description_en: Your menu bar gets cluttered fast. Bartender is paid and asks for Accessibility permission. Hidden Bar works but feels stuck in 2015. Hide Icons is a one-file Swift utility that does the spacer trick — Cmd-drag the icons you want to hide to the left of the chevron, click the chevron, they're pushed off screen. Click again, they're back. ~5 MB RAM, no helper process, no telemetry, no Accessibility prompt. Open source on GitHub.
description_hr: Menu bar se brzo zatrpa ikonama. Bartender se plaća i traži Accessibility dozvolu. Hidden Bar radi, ali UI je zaglavljen u 2015. Hide Icons je Swift utility koji koristi spacer trik — Cmd-drag ikone koje želiš sakriti lijevo od chevrona, klikni chevron, izguraju se izvan ekrana. Klikni opet — vraćaju se. ~5 MB RAM, bez helper procesa, bez telemetrije, bez Accessibility prompta. Open source na GitHubu.

name: ActivityBar
tagline_en: Live CPU, RAM and SSD in your macOS menu bar — with the processes and folders behind the numbers.
tagline_hr: CPU, RAM i SSD uživo u macOS menu baru — s procesima i mapama iza tih brojeva.
description_en: Activity Monitor makes you switch windows. Paid alternatives ship 200 features you don't need. ActivityBar shows live CPU, RAM and SSD in the corner of your screen — then lets you act on them: CPU and RAM open the hungriest processes so you can kill one from the menu, and SSD opens your largest folders and keeps drilling until you find whatever filled the disk. Native Swift, a single file, ad-hoc signed .app, and the icon is generated programmatically. Around 0.2% CPU at rest. Open source on GitHub.
description_hr: Activity Monitor te tjera da napustiš prozor u kojem radiš. Plaćene alternative dolaze s 200 značajki koje ti ne trebaju. ActivityBar prikazuje CPU, RAM i SSD uživo u kutu ekrana — i pušta te da nešto poduzmeš: CPU i RAM otvaraju najgladnije procese pa ga možeš ubiti iz menija, a SSD otvara tvoje najveće mape i kopa dalje dok ne nađeš što ti je popunilo disk. Nativni Swift, jedna datoteka, ad-hoc potpisani .app, a ikona je generirana programski. Oko 0,2% CPU-a u mirovanju. Open source na GitHubu.

name: Native Browser
tagline_en: A lightweight, privacy-first browser built natively for Apple Silicon.
tagline_hr: Lagani browser usmjeren na privatnost, izgrađen nativno za Apple Silicon.
description_en: Stop running Chrome's bloat on your M-series Mac. Native Browser uses WebKit and Apple's native frameworks for blazing-fast performance, minimal RAM usage, and zero telemetry.
description_hr: Prestanite trošiti resurse svog M-serija Maca na Chromeov bloat. Native Browser koristi WebKit i Appleove izvorne okvire za munjevitu izvedbu, minimalnu potrošnju RAM-a i bez ikakve telemetrije.

name: DockGuard
tagline_en: Lock your macOS Dock so it never moves, resizes, or rearranges again.
tagline_hr: Zaključajte svoj macOS Dock — bez slučajnog pomicanja, promjene veličine ili rasporeda.
description_en: Tired of accidentally dragging icons off your Dock or resizing it by mistake? DockGuard prevents accidental changes while keeping the Dock fully functional. One toggle in your menu bar — that's it. Open source on GitHub — clone, build, and contribute.
description_hr: Umorni ste od slučajnog povlačenja ikona s Docka ili promjene veličine? DockGuard sprječava slučajne promjene dok zadržava punu funkcionalnost Docka. Jedan prekidač u menu baru — i gotovo. Open source na GitHubu — klonirajte, izgradite, doprinosite.

name: StayAwake
tagline_en: Keep your Mac awake when you need it. One click in your menu bar.
tagline_hr: Držite svoj Mac budnim kad vam treba. Jedan klik u menu baru.
description_en: Long downloads, Zoom calls, presentations, render jobs — sometimes you just need your Mac to stay awake without messing with Energy Saver settings. StayAwake adds one icon to your menu bar: click it on, your Mac stays awake. Click off, it goes back to normal sleep behavior. No daemons, no settings to dig through, no fluff.
description_hr: Dugi downloadi, Zoom pozivi, prezentacije, renderiranje — ponekad jednostavno trebate da vam Mac ostane budan bez petljanja po Energy Saver postavkama. StayAwake dodaje jednu ikonu u menu bar: kliknete je, Mac ostaje budan. Kliknete ponovno, vraća se na uobičajeno ponašanje. Bez daemona, bez kopanja po postavkama, bez kompliciranja.

name: Klik
tagline_en: Screenshots, screen recording and GIFs on your Mac — annotate, then drag straight into any app. A 700 KB native alternative to CleanShot.
tagline_hr: Screenshotovi, snimanje ekrana i GIF-ovi na Macu — anotiraj pa povuci ravno u bilo koju aplikaciju. Nativna alternativa CleanShotu od 700 KB.
description_en: Klik is a menu bar screen capture tool built the way CleanShot works, without the subscription. It captures a region, a window or the whole screen through ScreenCaptureKit, opens an annotation editor with rectangles, arrows, text, highlight, gaussian blur and crop, and can pin any screenshot so it floats above every other window. Video recording covers the full screen or a region in HEVC with a 1080p ceiling, capturing system audio and the microphone as separate tracks — echo cancellation and a mixdown into one sharing-friendly AAC track run automatically after every recording, so a meeting is ready to send without a re-compression pass. Any recording converts to an optimized GIF in one click. Every capture slides into the corner of the screen and drags straight out into Slack, Mail, Finder or a browser upload. Zero third-party dependencies, no telemetry, no network code — a single 700 KB native app for Apple Silicon. MIT licensed.
description_hr: Klik je alat za snimanje ekrana iz menu bara, napravljen po uzoru na CleanShot, ali bez pretplate. Hvata regiju, prozor ili cijeli ekran kroz ScreenCaptureKit, otvara editor za anotacije s pravokutnicima, strelicama, tekstom, markerom, blurom i cropom, a svaki screenshot možeš pribosti da lebdi iznad svih prozora. Snimanje videa pokriva cijeli ekran ili regiju u HEVC-u s granicom od 1080p, uz sistemski zvuk i mikrofon kao zasebne zapise — uklanjanje jeke i spajanje u jedan AAC zapis idu automatski nakon svake snimke, pa je sastanak spreman za slanje bez dodatne kompresije. Bilo koja snimka se jednim klikom pretvara u optimizirani GIF. Svaka snimka sklizne u kut ekrana i povuče se ravno u Slack, Mail, Finder ili upload u pregledniku. Nula vanjskih ovisnosti, bez telemetrije, bez mrežnog koda — jedna nativna aplikacija od 700 KB za Apple Silicon. MIT licenca.
